objective.name: brique.intention
objective.description: Extract a Brique intention from an MCP message received from the LLM, forward it to the Brique engine, and wrap the response into an MCP-compliant message returned to the LLM.

#root.role: Transform an MCP message carrying a Brique intention into an MCP response carrying the Brique engine result.

transformation_contract.morphing: An MCP message carrying a Brique intention becomes an MCP response carrying the Brique engine result.
invariants: The intention is forwarded to Brique without modification.
The Brique response semantic content is preserved without alteration in the MCP wrapper.
success: The LLM receives a valid MCP response containing the Brique engine response payload.
failure: The capacity fails when the MCP message does not carry a valid Brique intention.
The capacity fails when the Brique engine returns an error or times out.

#extract_intention.role: Extract the Brique intention payload from the incoming MCP message.

transformation_contract.morphing: A raw MCP message becomes an explicit Brique intention payload ready for dispatch.
invariants: The intention payload is extracted without modification.
success: intention contains a valid non-empty Brique intention object.
failure: The section fails when the MCP message does not contain a Brique intention payload.

#dispatch.role: Forward the extracted intention to the Brique engine and await the response.

transformation_contract.morphing: A Brique intention becomes an explicit Brique engine response after synchronous dispatch.
invariants: The intention is transmitted to Brique without modification.
success: brique_response contains the response payload returned by the Brique engine.
failure: The section fails when Brique returns an error or the request times out.

#wrap_response.role: Wrap the Brique engine response into an MCP-compliant message to be returned to the LLM.

transformation_contract.morphing: A raw Brique engine response becomes a well-formed MCP response message ready to be returned to the LLM.
invariants: The Brique response semantic content is preserved without alteration.
success: mcp_response conforms to the MCP protocol response structure.
mcp_response carries the full Brique engine response payload.
failure: The section fails when the Brique response is empty or malformed.
